jobs.title: Chief of Staff - Commercial Strategy
jobs.description:
Arcadia is dedicated to happier, healthier days for all. We believe that there is a better healthcare world – one powered by data. Our platform transforms complex, diverse data into a unified foundation for health, helping organizations deliver better care, boost revenue, and lower costs. 
 
We’re a team of fiercely driven individuals committed to making healthcare more sustainable—and we’re looking for passionate people to help us get there.
 
For more information, visit arcadia.io.
 
Arcadia helps healthcare and life sciences organizations deliver measurable results. We unify fragmented data across the healthcare ecosystem so payers, providers, ACOs, and life sciences companies can make confident decisions grounded in trustworthy intelligence. Our platform supports more than 200 organizations and 40 million attributed lives across value-based care, risk adjustment, population health, and life sciences programs. 
Why This Role Is Important to Arcadia
Arcadia is at a growth stage where the connective tissue between ideation, execution, and executive decision-making matters enormously. This primarily manifests across two areas today: (1) Growth (Strategy, Sales, and Retention & Expansion) and (2) cross-functional Executive initiatives. This role sits at that intersection: you will partner with the Chief Commercial Officer to identify and launch new growth initiatives—whether that's a new vertical, a new go-to-market partnership, or a new solution while also engaging directly with the executive team to drive alignment on the initiatives that matter most across the company. In practice, this typically plays out as roughly 75% of your time on commercial strategy and growth initiatives, and roughly 25% partnering directly with the executive team and supporting the Chief Executive Officer.
This is a role of ownership and initiative, not execution-on-request. You will be given real latitude to define how new opportunities get approached, how cross-functional work gets organized, and how the executive team stays aligned—and you'll be trusted to run with it. You will report to the Chief Commercial Officer and partner closely with Product, Clinical, Value Enablement, Sales Engineering, Marketing, Actuary, Account Management, and the broader executive team.

What You'll Be Doing
Launch New Growth Initiatives

You will partner across the Commercial, Value Enablement, and Product teams to identify and pursue new paths to growth—whether that's a new vertical, a strategic partnership, a new product or solution go-to-market motion, or another initiative altogether—taking ownership of the work from initial concept through initial traction.

- Identify and size new growth opportunities by understanding the market, our competitive position, and where Arcadia's assets and talent can be leveraged to win

- Build the business case for each opportunity: market sizing, financial rationale, resourcing needs, and risks, so leadership can make a clear go or no-go decision

- Partner with Thought Leadership, Value Enablement, Product, Clinical, Partnerships, and other domain SMEs as needed to shape the specifics of each initiative—what it is, who it's for, and how it comes together

- Build the GTM positioning  and competitive differentiation for each initiative, grounded in Arcadia's outcomes-first brand and validated against real buyer needs

- Translate the business case into a tactical execution plan, and drive that plan forward: coordinate cross-functional workstreams, resolve dependencies, and keep the initiative moving toward real traction

- Define success criteria for each initiative and track progress against commitments

Strengthen GTM Motion

New markets don't succeed in isolation—they depend on a commercial engine that's tightly coordinated. You will take initiative to close gaps and accelerate growth across the teams that make GTM work and bring visibility into that progress at the executive level.

- Build and refresh competitive intelligence in target markets, synthesizing signals from win/loss data, market research, analyst commentary, and field input

- Collaborate with Value Enablement and Solutions Consulting to improve discovery-to-proposal velocity, solution credibility, and RFP quality

- Partner with Actuary to sharpen financial modeling, risk quantification, and ROI frameworks used in payer and risk-bearing organization deals

- Facilitate cross-functional alignment meetings, manage project tracking for strategic commercial initiatives, and proactively remove blockers

- Bring commercial progress, risks, and decisions needing executive input directly into board and executive committee conversations

Executive Team  Support

As Arcadia scales, the initiatives that matter most increasingly cut across teams and leaders—commercial expansion chief among them. This role gives you a direct seat in that conversation, extending the alignment work you do in Commercial to the executive team as a whole.

- Drive the Executive Committee Operating Rhythm: Help shape and run the weekly executive committee meeting -- build agendas, synthesize pre-reads, capture decisions, and drive follow-through across leaders

- Partner on board meeting preparation, ensuring materials reflect a coherent narrative across commercial, product, and financial priorities

- Take ownership of cross-functional strategic initiatives that span multiple teams and executives, acting as the driver who keeps them moving and accountable

- Proactively surface where executive-level initiatives are stalling and broker resolution before they become bigger problems

- Take on special projects with the executive team as they arise, applying the same ownership and rigor used in the commercial work

What Success Looks Like

In the first 90 days, you have mapped the highest-priority growth opportunities in front of Arcadia, built relationships across Product, Clinical, Value Enablement, Marketing, and the executive team, and built the business case for at least one priority initiative.

In year one, you have taken two or more growth initiatives from concept to real traction—whether new verticals, partnerships, or products—contributed measurably to pipeline generation and competitive win rates, and become a trusted driver of alignment within the executive committee and board cadence.
What You'll Bring
Required

- Seven or more years in healthcare GTM strategy, strategy consulting, or a commercial leadership role

- Deep fluency in the payer or provider landscape—you can speak credibly to value-based care, population health, risk adjustment, quality and Stars

- Demonstrated experience taking a growth idea from concept to traction in a B2B healthcare context—building the business case, shaping the go-to-market approach, and driving execution

- Experience partnering with executives or a board on operating rhythms, including meeting preparation, cross-functional tracking, and driving follow-through on strategic commitments

- Strong cross-functional collaborator who can align product, clinical, finance, sales, and executive stakeholders behind a common strategy

- Comfort working in ambiguity—this role requires structuring undefined problems and building the plan, not executing a defined playbook

- Excellent written and verbal communication; able to build crisp, compelling narratives for executive, board, and buyer audiences

Preferred

- Experience with data and analytics platforms sold to payers, ACOs, or risk-bearing organizations

- Familiarity with buyer segments beyond traditional payer and provider markets—including self-funded employers, risk-bearing entities, or adjacent healthcare services organizations

- Prior experience as a chief of staff, or in a strategy-and-operations role partnering closely with a CEO or executive committee
What You'll Get
- Competitive compensation and strong benefits

- Employee-driven programs and initiatives for personal and professional development

- Membership in the talented, energized, diverse, and purpose-driven Arcadian Community

- Be a part of a mission driven company that is transforming the healthcare industry by changing the way patients receive care
About Arcadia
Arcadia.io helps innovative providers and payers across the country transform healthcare to reduce cost while improving patient health. We do this by aggregating large amounts of disparate data, applying algorithms to identify opportunities to provide better patient care, and making those opportunities actionable by physicians at the point of care in near-real time. We are passionate about helping our customers drive meaningful outcomes. We are growing fast and have emerged as a market leader in the highly competitive population health management software market and have been recognized by industry analysts KLAS, IDC, Forrester, and Chilmark for our leadership. For a better sense of our brand and products, please explore our website.

Protect Yourself
If you have concerns about the authenticity of a job offer or recruitment-related communication claiming to be from Arcadia, we encourage you to verify by contacting us directly at (781) 202-3600 and select option 3. For more information, visit our website.

This position is responsible for following all Security policies and procedures in order to protect all PHI under Arcadia's custodianship as well as Arcadia Intellectual Properties.  For any security-specific roles, the responsibilities would be further defined by the hiring manager.

jobs.title: Customer Success Manager
jobs.description:
Arcadia is dedicated to happier, healthier days for all. We believe that there is a better healthcare world – one powered by data. Our platform transforms complex, diverse data into a unified foundation for health, helping organizations deliver better care, boost revenue, and lower costs. 
 
We’re a team of fiercely driven individuals committed to making healthcare more sustainable—and we’re looking for passionate people to help us get there.
 
For more information, visit arcadia.io.
 
Why This Role Is Important to Arcadia 
 
At Arcadia.io, the Customer Success Manager (CSM) has complete responsibility for end-to-end customer success for Arcadia’s non-enterprise clients. CSMs commit to the ongoing work of making satisfied customers, through ensuring collective adoption of Arcadia capabilities, strong data quality, rapid and effective support, and smooth upgrades. The CSM displays an intimate understanding of Arcadia functionality and can marry this understanding with their knowledge of value-based care to lead product training, mitigate issues, and reconfigure tools to meet new business goals. A CSM’s experience and skills enable them to independently manage a portfolio of customer accounts operating as the clients’ primary point of contact. CSMs build long term relationships with their clients and are vested in their success.
 
CSMs have a knack for connecting strategic business objectives to Arcadia’s capabilities, enjoy getting into the weeds, and excel at critical problem solving. The CSM leads cross-functional teams to effectively troubleshoot, and project manage complex technical issues. As the customer’s primary point of contact, the CSM will prioritize executing projects to support each client’s business objectives, increasing the adoption of Arcadia tools and capabilities, manage post-initial implementation projects, communicate timelines, and be the first line of expertise and support for Arcadia customers.
 
In this position, you will work closely with division leaders, implementation management, production support SMEs, engineering, product managers and service desk teams.
 
What Success Looks Like
In 3 months
·  Complete Arcadia Core Platform certification and onboarding requirements
·  Successfully onboard to all customers in assigned portfolio 
·  Coordinate with internal teams to create and execute against project timelines
·  Communicate project status updates to customer leadership
·  Provide support to assigned customer accounts with oversight
·  Know each assigned customers’ scope of work and overarching Arcadia use cases
·  Drive issue resolution through coordination with internal teams
·  Show a base understanding of how Arcadia supports several population health programs focused on Cost, Utilization, Quality and Risk performance 
·  Have a strong understanding of Arcadia’s security protocols and processes
·  Convey ideas and solutions effectively, professionally and with the appropriate sensitivity through verbal and written communication  
 
In 6 months
·  Act as the primary CSM on assigned customer accounts with minimal oversight
·  Manage day to day operations of each customer
·  Train customers on the base platform and be able to tailor the training to customers’ needs
·  Understand Arcadia’s data ingestion processes and be able to troubleshoot processing issues at a high-level
·  Be knowledgeable on a customer’s strategic goals and initiatives supported through Arcadia
·  Be able to guide clients through recommended product configurations that are in alignment with clients’ goals and initiatives 
·  Assist in leading and executing planning and adoption workshops with customers  
·  Use technical skills and critical thinking to assist in investigating highly complex issues. Develop and execute against remediation plans
·  Understand and translate issue impact relative to customers’ business needs
·  Full accountability for managing small to medium implementation projects for Arcadia data feeds and applications
·  Develop strategic customer roadmaps, focusing on growth, adoption, and partnership in collaboration with management
·  Leverage Arcadia tools to monitor adoption of Arcadia capabilities and flag risks
·  Assist management in designing and executing a contract renewal strategy for an applicable customer 
 
In 12 months
·  Manage several customer accounts independently 
·  Train customers across Arcadia product suite
·  Demonstrate fluency in the interconnectivity between product functionality, data quality, data dependencies, and a client’s end use case
·  Develop strategies to help a client reach their business goals through solutioning, product configuration changes and trainings
·  Have full accountability in developing strategic customer roadmaps, focusing on growth, adoption, and partnership 
·  Assist in the onboarding and mentoring of new Customer Success Analysts and Customer Success Managers
·  Work with product and engineering teams to relay customer feedback on feature improvements.
·  Assist in the onboarding and mentoring of new Customer Success Analysts and Customer Success Managers

What You'll Be Doing
- Serving as the primary day-to-day point of contact for customers live on the Arcadia platform

- Connecting the dots between platform functionality, data dependencies/data model, and customer use cases to support capability adoption plans

- Be a resource with shared accountability for achieving and maintaining high Net Promoter Scores for assigned customers

- Driving adoption and scaling the use of Arcadia capabilities at your customers to pave a path for Arcadia capability growth

- Investigating escalated and highly complex issues to develop remediation plans with internal teams. Driving complex issue resolution through collaboration with cross-functional Arcadia teams

- Managing the implementation of product upgrades, significant platform changes, annual quality measure updates, and data integration quality control processes.

- Developing strong customers relationships and effectively communicating issue root cause/remediation and product functionality

- Learning customers’ business goals to facilitate internal decisions, e.g. strategize platform upgrades, prioritization of updates, understand issue impact, internal escalation and managing platform adoption.

- Conducting customer trainings and demos across the Arcadia product suite to facilitate adoption

- Acting as the translator between internal and external teams regarding complex technical concepts and business needs

- Educating customers on Arcadia processes including data integration, data processing, upgrades, issue resolution

- Gaining an in depth understanding of value-based care and how Arcadia tools support customers to achieve success across multiple population health programs

- Mastering the Arcadia Product Suite and understanding Arcadia’s data flow processes to be first line of support for customers

- Leveraging tools such as Jira, Confluence, Smartsheet, and SQL
What You'll Bring
- Years related work experience; Customer Success Manager: 5+

- Bachelor’s degree in IT or related technical field (Computer Science, Information Management, Mathematics, or other analytical discipline) or equivalent professional work experience

- Experience working in technology or healthcare, preferably on the vendor side

- Strong communication skills including the ability to interact with customers and explain technical concepts and product functionality clearly

- Experience communicating with a wide range of audiences (tech, business, clinical, executive)

- Excellent presentation and communication skills, including the ability to create compelling materials in Microsoft PowerPoint, Excel, Word, etc.

- Regularly learn new skills, make timely decisions, and adapt well to change

- Strong analytical, quantitative, problem solving and organizations skills

- Attention to detail and ability to coordinate multiple tasks, set priorities and meet deadlines

- Thrive as a self-starter with the curiosity and tenacity to learn complex concepts

- Exceptional ability to complete committed follow-ups and tasks

- Ability to travel approximately 30%.
Would Love for You to Have
- Multiple years in IT support or relevant experience. Healthcare industry experience is a plus

- Experience using technologies such as SQL Server, Microsoft Office, JIRA and others to aid our customers in resolving complex big data issues. Additional programming language experience is a plus

- Experience interacting with Product and Engineering teams to identify and implement improvements to the software, and installation and configuration processes based on field Experience in value-based care. A robust understanding of EHR and claims data

- Proven ability to lead successful client meetings with executive, operational, clinical, and technical stakeholders.

- Knowledge of HIPAA, experience with EHR and/or Claims data, or experience in a secure data systems environment is a plus
What You'll Get
- Support a wide variety of customers in the healthcare space – all focused on pulling healthcare tech into modernity

- Be a part of a mission driven company that is transforming the healthcare industry by changing the way patients receive care

- A flexible, remote friendly company with personality and heart

- Employee driven programs and initiatives for personal and professional development

Arcadia.io helps innovative providers and payers across the country transform healthcare to reduce cost while improving patient health. We do this by aggregating large amounts of disparate data, applying algorithms to identify opportunities to provide better patient care, and making those opportunities actionable by physicians at the point of care in near-real time. We are passionate about helping our customers drive meaningful outcomes. We are growing fast and have emerged as a market leader in the highly competitive population health management software market and have been recognized by industry analysts KLAS, IDC, Forrester, and Chilmark for our leadership. jobs.title: Director, Business Development - Life Sciences
jobs.description:
Arcadia is dedicated to happier, healthier days for all. We believe that there is a better healthcare world – one powered by data. Our platform transforms complex, diverse data into a unified foundation for health, helping organizations deliver better care, boost revenue, and lower costs.
We're a team of fiercely driven individuals committed to making healthcare more sustainable—and we're looking for passionate people to help us get there.
For more information, visit arcadia.io.
Why this role is important to Arcadia
Arcadia is building a direct-to–Life Sciences commercial function as a strategic growth pillar of the company. The Director, Business Development - Life Sciences is an individual contributor seller responsible for building and closing enterprise relationships with pharmaceutical and biotechnology companies within an assigned account territory.
This is a true end-to-end selling role. You will prospect and develop new opportunities, lead discovery conversations with scientific and commercial stakeholders, scope and price solutions, negotiate contracts, and partner closely with internal teams to ensure successful delivery and long-term client satisfaction.
This role is designed for a life sciences seller with fluency in real-world data, analytics, and evidence-based solutions—someone who understands how pharma organizations buy across the development lifecycle and who wants to build a durable book of business inside Arcadia's growing direct Life Sciences sales organization.
 
What Success Looks Like
In 3 months
Build a deep understanding of Arcadia's Life Sciences data, solutions, operating model, and delivery capabilities
Establish credibility and working rhythm with Product, Data, Ops, Delivery, Legal, and Finance
Build a qualified pipeline within your assigned account territory, leveraging existing relationships and Arcadia's differentiated data assets
Complete onboarding on Arcadia's Life Sciences value narrative, competitive positioning, and pricing framework
In 6 months
Advance a meaningful, qualified pipeline aligned to pharma planning and budgeting cycles
Close at least one deal or be in late-stage contracting on priority opportunities
Demonstrate strong deal scoping discipline with smooth handoffs into delivery
Maintain accurate CRM hygiene and deliver a reliable forecast to your manager
In 12 months
Consistently attain quota with a 3-5x quota, well-qualified pipeline across your territory
Close multiple deals with clear expansion potential, including at least one multi-year or enterprise agreement
Build strong relationships with scientific, commercial, and procurement stakeholders where Arcadia is viewed as a trusted partner
Provide market feedback that influences packaging, pricing, or roadmap prioritization

What You'll Be Doing
PROSPECT AND BUILD A QUALIFIED LIFE SCIENCES PIPELINE

- Proactively build pipeline in a green-field or assigned Life Sciences territory using conference presence, publication monitoring, thought leadership networks, hunting via warm and cold outreach, leveraging of BDR Team, and CRO or consultancy partnerships

- Identify and prioritize high-probability targets using a defined ideal customer profile: company size, therapeutic area focus, pipeline stage, and recent approvals

- Map multi-threaded stakeholder ecosystems across R&D, HEOR, medical, market access, and commercial teams at target accounts

- Maintain rigorous pipeline hygiene using a defined qualification methodology (e.g., MEDDIC, MEDDPICC, or BANT) to advance or deprioritize opportunities

LEAD SOLUTION SELLING ACROSS THE PHARMA DEVELOPMENT LIFECYCLE

- Lead discovery conversations across early research, clinical development, HEOR/RWE, market access, and commercial analytics

- Translate complex client needs into well-scoped solutions that balance data, analytics, services, and delivery realities

- Guide clients toward use cases where Arcadia can deliver outsized value, not lowest-friction data transactions

- Align solutions to client budgeting and planning cycles, including annual and multi-year funding processes

CONDUCT CONSULTATIVE, VALUE-BASED SELLING

- Lead structured discovery that surfaces business problems and internal success metrics before any product discussion

- Build ROI and business cases using the customer's own metrics and language, validated by the scientific or commercial champion

- Adapt selling approach and content to the buyer persona and Use Case - modulating message and proof points accordingly

NEGOTIATE AND CLOSE COMMERCIAL AGREEMENTS

- Structure enterprise data agreements—licensing, DUAs, MSAs, usage-based pricing—that protect margin while delivering clear buyer value

- Exercise strong commercial judgment on deal structure, pricing, and scope, with a clear negotiating position and walk-away point on every deal

- Respond to procurement pressure by re-anchoring to validated scientific and commercial value rather than discounting immediately

- Own the full lifecycle:

- Opportunity qualification

- Solution design and scoping

- Proposal and SOW development

- Pricing and commercial structuring

- Contract negotiation and close

- Partner closely with legal, finance, and leadership to finalize terms efficiently

COLLABORATE ACROSS TEAMS AND MAINTAIN FORECAST DISCIPLINE

- Partner effectively with data science, medical, product, legal, and delivery teams to configure and present solutions that meet complex customer requirements

- Orchestrate internal resources without over-committing them, and manage a clean handoff to delivery and customer success to protect revenue

- Maintain accurate, up-to-date CRM records and deliver reliable forecasts, distinguishing clearly between commit, best case, and pipeline

- Contribute market and competitive feedback that informs product roadmap, packaging, and pricing decisions
What You'll Bring 
- 5+ years of experience selling into pharmaceutical and/or biotechnology companies, ideally in a quota-carrying, individual contributor role

- Demonstrated success selling data-, analytics-, or evidence-driven solutions (RWD, RWE/HEOR, clinical analytics, or adjacent offerings)

- Deep working knowledge of Life Sciences functional area—HEOR, Medical Affairs, Clinical Development, or Payer/Market Access—including how that function makes decisions and purchases data and analytics solutions

- Proven ability to engage scientific buyers (PhDs, MDs, biostatisticians, epidemiologists) with credibility on methodology , study design, and data fit-for-purpose

- Experience structuring and negotiating enterprise data licensing agreements, including DUAs, MSAs, and usage-based pricing models

- A disciplined approach to pipeline management and forecasting, using a defined qualification methodology

- Strong cross-functional collaboration skills and comfort operating in a build-mode commercial environment
Would Love For You To Have
- Existing senior relationships within pharma or biotech that can accelerate early pipeline development

- Familiarity with FDA RWE Framework, EMA guidance, or ISPOR methodology standards

- Experience selling into more than one Life Sciences functional area (e.g., both HEOR and Medical Affairs)

- Active presence in relevant industry conferences (ISPOR, ASCO, ASH, DIA, AMCP) and referral relationships with CROs or HEOR consultancies

- MEDDIC or MEDDPICC certification, or equivalent formal sales methodology training
What You'll Get
- Arcadia brings a rare advantage to Life Sciences: a  market-leading, scaled payer and provider platform as its foundation

- For more than a decade, Arcadia has been the trusted data and analytics partner to health systems, physician groups, and payers nationwide. That core business provides deep, longitudinal clinical and claims data, embedded clinical workflows, and durable relationships across the healthcare ecosystem

- Building on this foundation, Arcadia has assembled a large, de-identified real-world dataset combining claims and clinically rich EHR data sourced directly from provider systems. The result is a longitudinal, research-grade asset with depth and clinical context that is difficult to replicate through aggregation alone

- Life Sciences is a strategic pillar built on this foundation. Arcadia has made a deliberate, multi-year investment in:

- Purpose-built real-world data assets

- Clinically connected solutions that link insight back into provider workflows

- A growing research and collaboration ecosystem to expand data use rights

- Dedicated leadership, product, data, and operational resources

- The opportunity is to sell—and help shape—solutions that connect data, analytics, and real-world clinical activation across the pharma development lifecycle, backed by enterprise credibility and executive commitment

- This role is a founding, hands-on commercial leadership role, accountable for building the direct Life Sciences revenue engine, and deeply involved in shaping deals, messaging, and market positioning

- This role is not a  channel-only or account maintenance role, a narrowly scoped quota-carrying role with a fixed playbook, and insulated from product, delivery, or execution realities

Arcadia.io helps innovative providers and payers across the country transform healthcare to reduce cost while improving patient health. We do this by aggregating large amounts of disparate data, applying algorithms to identify opportunities to provide better patient care, and making those opportunities actionable by physicians at the point of care in near-real time. We are passionate about helping our customers drive meaningful outcomes. Our sales and contracting process
